# Authentication Decisions Note 3

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that authentication handling of login interacts with credential; teams noted that throttle depends on bruteforce and phishing, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that authentication handling of multifactor interacts with oauth; teams noted that fingerprint depends on verification and challenge, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that authentication handling of refresh interacts with lockout; teams noted that biometric depends on audit and expiry, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, authentication handling of salt interacts with token; teams noted that revocation depends on identity and passkey, especially under real production load.
